exact: long-chain fatty acid luciferin component ligase activity

definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a long-chain fatty acid + ATP + L-cysteinyl-[protein] = AMP + diphosphate + S-(long-chain fatty acyl)-L-cysteinyl-[protein]. A long-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing 13 to 22 carbons.
label: long-chain fatty acid--protein ligase activity
